run_train_cifar10: run the CIFAR10 training script with mixup augmentation for 200 epochs using ResNet18
run_train_resume_checkpoint: resume CIFAR10 training from a saved checkpoint using the --resume flag
run_train_custom_model: run CIFAR10 training with a custom model type and learning rate via CLI args
run_train_no_augment: run CIFAR10 training without data augmentation using the --no-augment flag
run_train_custom_mixup: run CIFAR10 training with a custom mixup alpha interpolation coefficient
